params.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic commercial, golden-hour city street, handheld, fast-cut multi-shot, white lace camisole and gold chain choker throughout. Identity lock: it is the same woman in every shot, with exactly the face of image 1 (same eyes, nose, lips, face shape, skin and makeup). The face never changes; only the hair changes. Images 2–6 are this same woman with different hair; copy each hairstyle exactly and keep her face from image 1. Shot 1 (0–2s): she walks toward camera along a tree-lined street with the ash-blonde cut of image 2, raises her phone for a selfie. Shot 2 (2–4s): phone-screen POV; shutter flash; in the photo her hair is now the black-and-red wolf cut of image 3; pull back to reveal the real her on the street also has that wolf cut; a red bus passes in the foreground and wipes the frame. Shot 3 (4–6s): side tracking shot at a zebra crossing, she has the high orange ponytail of image 4, hops off the kerb mid-stride taking a selfie, ponytail swinging; whip pan. Shot 4 (6–8s): through a café window, she sits with a latte, hair in the honey-brown waves of image 5, lifts the cup then takes a selfie; a glass door edge slides across the frame. Shot 5 (8–10s): locked selfie framing, her face centred and smiling, with the twin tails of image 6, the background changing on each beat: graffiti wall, rooftop at dusk, riverside rail. Photoreal.
